description: Preferring another seat clears only other same-kind preferences.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.explorer-seat]
kind = "codex"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:test"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[accounts.second]
kind = "codex"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:second"
